Name: Twitch Chat Mod
Author: Miihau
Description:
[center][size=6][u][b][color=#8e7cc3]Twitch Chat[/color] Mod[/b][/u][/size]
[size=5]This Mod tracks the specified [color=#8e7cc3]Twitch Chat[/color] in the Stardew in game chat.[/size]
[size=3] [/size]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/miihau][img]https://i.ibb.co/jbZNLr7/61e11d430afb112ea33c3aa5-Button-1-p-500-1.png[/img][/url][/center][url=https://ko-fi.com/miihau]
[/url]
[size=5][b][u]How it works[/u][/b] [/size][size=2](this is also explained in game in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url])[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]add the[color=#8e7cc3] [/color][color=#b4a7d6]Twitch username[/color] of the channels chat you want to track in the config. ([u][color=#ea9999]no[/color][/u] login or API key needed :3)[/size]
[*][size=2]add the [color=#b4a7d6]Twitch usernames[/color] that you don't want to show up in chat in the config. (for example your ChatBot) (separate multiple names by comma like this: [i]Miihau,Bothau[/i]) [/size]
[*][size=2]resize the in game chat to your liking in the config. (I recommend 0.6 width and max 6 messages)[/size]
[*][size=2]start a save file and the [color=#b4a7d6]Twitch chat[/color] will be tracked in your stardew chat[/size]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31014]Commands Mod[/url]

If you look for a version of this type of mod that can also track redeems, follows, subs and such with a login and API,
then you should check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59183916]Hexenentendrache[/url]'s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17321]Twitch Chat Integration
